title: Weakly etale morphisms are local on the source
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $(u_a:U_a\to X)_{a\in J}$ be a family of open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] whose images cover $X$. Then $f$ is weakly etale [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism] if and only if every composite $f\circ u_a:U_a\to Y$ is weakly etale. The family may be empty when $X$ is empty.
